content: Jidɛun yaẓẓeř x ayt n Midyan

Yarubbaɛl, wa d Jidɛun, ikkar zic uřa d marra řgens i ɣares iǧan uca wtin nitni řmargeḥ n řɛeskar nsen ɣar tařa n Ḥarud. Řmargeḥ n Midyan tuɣa iǧan zzates ɣar ccamal, zi tewrirt n Mura di řewḍa n teɣzurt.
SIDI inna i Jidɛun: “Řgens i ɣarek iǧan aqa-t deg waṭṭas. Ammu war zemmareɣ ad asen ggeɣ Midyan deg ufus nsen, niɣ izemmar Israil ad xafi ifeyyec ad yini: ‘Afus inu issenjem ayi.’

S uya, řaɣa deg imezzuɣen n řgens, ini: ‘Wenni itteggʷeden d wenni ittarjijen ad iɛqeb uca ad iffeɣ deɣya zeg idurar n Jilɛad!’” Xenni ɛeqben tnayen u-ɛicrin-ařef n yeryazen zi řgens uca qqimen ɣares ɛecra-ařaf.

Maca SIDI inna i Jidɛun: “Řgens aqa-t ɛad deg waṭṭas. Sehwa ten ɣar waman, dinni ad ten ddzeɣ i cek. Ad imsar x wenni i d ac ɣa iniɣ: ‘Wa ad kik iraḥ!’, win ad kik iraḥ, maca kuř ijj i x d ac ɣa iniɣ: ‘Wanita war kik ittriḥ!’, win war kik ittriḥ.”

Issehwa řgens ɣar waman. Xenni inna as SIDI: “Kuř ijj wenni i ɣa iřesḥen aman s yiřes nnes, am mammec i ten iřesseḥ weqzin, ad t tegged ɣar ijj n ṭṭarf. Ammu uřa d marra inni i ɣa yaḍaren x ifadden maḥend ad swen.”
Řqedd n yinni iwyen aman s ufus nsen ɣar uqemmum nsen maḥend ad řesḥen aman s yiřes nsen, tuɣa aten di teřt-mya n yeryazen, maca marra inneɣni uḍaren x ifadden ḥima ad swen aman.

Xas uca inna SIDI i Jidɛun: “S ufus n teřt-mya n yeryazen-a, inni iřesḥen aman s yiřes nsen, ad kenniw ssnejmeɣ u Necc ad ggeɣ Midyan deg ufus nnec. Marra řgens nneɣni i iqqimen ad uyuren, kuř ijj ɣar wemcan nnes.

Nitni ksin řeɛweč n řgens d waccawen nsen n icarri deg ufus, umi netta issekk marra iryazen n Israil, kuř ijj ɣar uqiḍun nnes. Maca teřt-mya n yeryazen nni ijja i-ten ɣares. Tuɣa řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Midyan swadday nnes di řewḍa n teɣzurt.
Di ǧiřet nni temsar, aqa SIDI inna as: “Kkar bedd, hwa ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar, maɣar Necc ggiɣ ac ten deg ufus nnec.
Mařa cek aqa teggʷded ɛad maḥend ad dd-tehwid, hwa-dd xenni ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar ak-d Fura, amsexxar nnec.

Ad tesřed min xef ssawařen, uca xenni ad ac immewc jjehd deg ifassen nnec ařami ɣa tzemɛed ad tehwid ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar.” Xenni ihwa netta ak-d Fura, amsexxar nnes, ařami iwḍen ař zzat i terbiɛin isswejden i umenɣi ɣar ṭṭarf n řmargeḥ.
Uca Midyan d Ɛamaliq d marra ayt n ccarq tuɣa ssun di řewḍa n teɣzurt am yijj n weyřaf n tmurɣi u iřeɣman nsen war zemmaren ad ttwaḥesben, tuɣa aten deg waṭṭas am yijdi ɣar tma n řebḥar.

Umi yiweḍ Jidɛun din, xzar, ijj n weryaz, tuɣa ittḥaja i umeddukkeř nnes ict n tarjit, inna: “Xzar, necc ɣari ict n tarjit uca ẓriɣ mammec ijj n weɣrum n imendi i iwḍan ɣar swadday iqnunni-dd ɣar daxeř n řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Midyan uca yiweḍ ař aqiḍun uca iřqef i-t ařami iwḍa u idweř x uzeǧif. Aqa ammu i iwḍa uqiḍun.”
Yarra-dd xas umeddukkeř nnes, inna: “Aya war ixs ad yini mɣir ssif n Jidɛun, mmis n Yuwac, aryaz zi Israil. AREBBI iwca Midyan d marra řmargeḥ n řɛeskar deg ufus nnes.”
Umi isřa Jidɛun tarjit-a d min texs ad tini, yuḍar uca xenni iɛqeb ɣar řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Israil, inna: “Kkarem, SIDI igga řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Midyan deg ufus nwem.”
Jidɛun ibḍa teřt-mya n yeryazen x třata n ibaṭayunen uca iwca kuř ijj zzaysen ijj n uyicc n icarri deg ufus nnes d ijj n weqḍuḥ ixwan d ijj n uṣefḍaw deg weqḍuḥ.
Netta inna asen: “Xzarem-dd ɣari uca ggem amenni. Xzar, mařa iwḍeɣ ɣar ṭṭarf n řmargeḥ, xenni ad teggem uřa d kenniw am mammec i ɣa ggeɣ necc.
Xmi ɣa suḍeɣ necc deg uyicc n icarri uřa d marra inni ɣari iǧan, xenni ad tsuḍem uřa d kenniw deg waccawen n icarri ɣar marra iɣezdisen n řmargeḥ, ad tinim: ‘I SIDI u i Jidɛun!’”

Uca Jidɛun d mya n yeryazen nni tuɣa ɣares, iwḍen-dd ɣar ṭṭarf n řmargeḥ n řɛeskar ɣar umezwaru n tɛessast n wezyen n ǧiřet, umi ten tuɣa ɛad ggur ad ssbedden iɛessasen, uca suḍen deg waccawen n icarri, uca nitni wtin, arẓin iqḍuḥen nni ɣarsen deg ufus nsen.
Třata n ibaṭayunen suḍen deg waccawen n icarri uca arẓin iqḍuḥen u s ufus aẓeřmaḍ ṭṭfen iṣefḍawen u s ufus afusi accawen n icarri ḥima ad daysen suḍen uca sɣuyen: “Ssif n SIDI d Jidɛun!”
Qqimen bedden ɣar marra iɣezdisen n řmargeḥ kuř ijj deg wemcan nnes. Xenni bdan ad aẓẓřen marra inni iǧan di řmargeḥ, sɣuyen uca arewřen.

Umi suḍen teřt-mya n yeryazen deg waccawen n icarri, issekkar SIDI ssif n ijjen ḍidd i wenneɣni di marra řmargeḥ uca yarweř řɛeskar ař Bayt-Ciṭṭa, jjihet n Zarara ař tma n yeɣzar i iǧan ɣar Abil-Maḥula ɣar Ṭabbat.
Xenni řaɣan-dd x yeryazen n Israil, zi Naftali u zi Acir u zi marra Manassa uca ḍfaren nitni ayt n Midyan.

Ɛawed issekk Jidɛun ireqqasen ɣar marra idurar n Ifrayim, inna: “Hwam, uyurem ɣar umsagar ak-d ayt n Midyan u tekksem as iɣezran ař Bayt-Bara uřa d L’Urdun.” Ttwařaɣan marra iryazen n Ifrayim uca nitni ṭṭfen iɣezran ař Bayt-Bara d L’Urdun.

Nitni ḥebbsen tnayen n řḥukkam n Midyan, Ɣurab d Di’ab, uca nɣin Ɣurab x teṣḍart n Ɣurab u Di’ab nɣin t x tsirt n uḍiř n Di’ab uca nitni ɛerfen x Imidyaniyyen. Izeǧifen n Ɣurab d Di’ab iwyen ten ɣar Jidɛun x ujemmaḍ n L’Urdun.
